column1: # Original DICE Quadrapong, DIP 1 (1 coin / 2 credits: one coin buys a four-player
# game). One coin and Start; a recorded closed-loop rally of all four paddles
# (1200-11999 ms); every paddle parks at its low end until the game ends (46.5 s);
# Start alone does not restart without a credit (48000 ms); coin and Start restart a
# cleared four-player game (50000-51100 ms). Original SDL int16 axes.
